changeSet.sql:
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'integration' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Setting') BEGIN IF EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_IntegrationSynchedAssetType_IntegrationSetting' and object_name(parent_object_id) = 'SynchedAssetType' and schema_name(schema_id) = 'integration' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [integration].[SynchedAssetType] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_IntegrationSynchedAssetType_IntegrationSetting] END
exec sp_rename 'integration.Setting', 'Setting_backup'; END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'integration' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Setting_backup') BEGIN exec sp_rename 'integration.Setting_backup', 'Setting'; END
